description: Point de prélèvement d'eau au milieu naturel effectué pour l'irrigation dans le Haut-Rhin is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Positioning of water sampling points in the natural environment carried out for irrigation. These samples can be taken from the soil (water table or karst circulation), at the emergence of a source, or in the superficial hydrographic network (river or body of water). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualisation service (WMS) of the dataset: Point of water withdrawal from the natural environment carried out for i" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
